items.title: Tech Stocks Shake Off Another Memory Stock Slide
items.summary: Three of its top holdings, flash memory/data storage companies Seagate, Western Digital, and Sandisk, were among the biggest losers in the S&P 500 Friday.  The stocks continued to slide following Western Digital's earnings late Wednesday, which were merely good as opposed to mind-blowingly fantastic.  The memory ETF was being dragged down even more by Micron Technology and South Korean rival SK Hynix.
